scope: Runtime overhead and deploy package size; no gameplay, art pixels or timing changes

measurements.note: Major size saving is the upload package, not JS or first-load transfer. Retired images were copied by static packaging but were not necessarily requested by gameplay.

runtimeChanges: Bounded shared numeric glyph/pattern caches and one measurement canvas; identical width calculation and font-load invalidation.
Numeric resize/font observers survive text updates rather than being recreated for each amount.
Canvas backing dimensions are written only when changed; current DPR caps and render quality preserved.
Idle board updates avoid travel-only layout reads.
Closed gates defer full-screen art decoding; existing playback prewarm remains before visible animation clocks.
Gate initial resize/draw does not enroll unrelated reactive state in renderer lifecycle.

validation.assetClosure: PASS: all referenced assets byte-identical to source before any output pruning
validation.numericControlledBenchmark: 100 equal-format updates: 1900 measureText calls before, 11 after; outputs equal. This is call-count evidence, not browser frame-time measurement.
validation.canvasControlledCheck: 100 identical resize calls: 2 dimension writes total instead of 200

delivery.originals: All source assets/provenance remain untouched in static; only reproducible generated build files are pruned.

remainingOpportunities: Profile real interaction/network and frame-time behavior once browser control is reconnected; repeated-warning root cause is not yet live-confirmed.
Delivery-only lossless WebP variants of large images may further reduce transfer; requires full atlas/reference updates and visual/pixel QA, so not done in this pass.
Inline-to-cacheable JS/CSS splitting and shared SDK locale trimming need launcher/replay/locale compatibility checks. Current inline delivery deliberately preserved.
Do not replace CSS filters or consolidate thirty symbol canvases without actual paint/draw profile evidence and motion regression QA.
